title: Act: Wrap Git failures and guard a nil Closer in Poll
summary: Make Pull and ListRounds errors abort Poll with wrapped messages and avoid a nil Closer panic
description: Finalize error semantics in Poller.Poll in poller.go.
acceptance_criteria: Pull and List errors return Result{} wrapped with %w.
A nil Closer yields an error for an expired Round.
definition_of_done: poller.go builds with the error semantics

steps.action: Wrap the Pull error as fmt.Errorf("poller: pull: %w", err) and the ListRounds error as fmt.Errorf("poller: list rounds: %w", err); both return Result{} immediately so no later call runs.
steps.expected: Pull or list failure returns an empty Result and a wrapped error.

steps.lines: the OPEN case added by act-close
steps.action: Before calling p.closer.Close, if p.closer == nil append errors.New("poller: no closer configured") to errs and continue.
steps.expected: A nil Closer produces an error and no panic.
